title: Command injection via string formatting
description: Shell commands constructed with f-strings. If project.script contains quotes + code, it results in arbitrary code execution.
recommendation: Use subprocess.run with list args (shell=False). Never pass untrusted data into -c strings.

title: Unauthenticated database download
description: /api/backup_db serves the entire SQLite database to anyone. Contains chat logs, system variables, command history.

title: Arbitrary file read via indexing
description: add_source_from_file reads any path. Attacker can read /etc/passwd or ~/.ssh/id_rsa and index into AI knowledge base.
recommendation: Restrict file reading to sandboxed directory. Validate path starts with ALLOWED_DIR.

title: Flask API completely unauthenticated
description: daniela_os.py does not import or use auth_system.py. All endpoints (/api/chat, /api/history, /api/commands) are open to the public. Anyone can send commands to the AI and read historical data.
recommendation: Import auth_system.py, create @require_auth decorator, apply to all /api/* routes. Issue JWT on PIN verification.

title: Hardcoded secret fallbacks
description: Insecure fallbacks for JWT secret ('aigestion-super-secret-key-change-in-production') and PIN (<redactado>). Attacker with source access can forge tokens.
recommendation: Remove fallbacks. Crash on startup if secrets missing.

title: FFmpeg command injection
description: File paths interpolated into shell commands. Quote injection possible.

title: Content factory not connected to Gemini
description: _generate_from_prompt returns formatted string, notes 'En una implementacion real, aqui iria una llamada a LLM'. Completely disconnected from gemini35_free_tier.py.
recommendation: Import ModelRouter from gemini35_free_tier.py. Replace stub with router.call('content_generation', prompt).

title: Code generation produces pass stubs
description: Templates generate body='pass' stubs. No actual functional code produced.
recommendation: Use Gemini 3.1 Pro to generate real code. For multi-file changes, dispatch Jules task.

title: Missing aigestion_adapters.py
description: Core loads aigestion_adapters.py which doesn't exist. Falls back to _stub_handler dead ends.
recommendation: Create aigestion_adapters.py mapping intents to real module functions.

title: No test suite
description: No pytest or unittest files. No tests/ directory. Self-healing can't validate fixes.
recommendation: Create tests/ directory. Add pytest tests for auth_system.py, aigestion_core.py, agent_vigia.py. Use Jules to generate tests.

title: No API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
description: Flask endpoints have no OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
recommendation: Add flask-smorest or flasgger for auto-generated API docs.

title: No refresh token rotation
description: Old refresh token not invalidated when used. Stolen token valid for 30 days.
recommendation: Implement refresh token rotation: delete old, issue new.
